input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month. "Net Sales" shall mean all revenues from the sale of Deerskin Products on the Site including shipping and handling charges, minus refunds and exchanges.
input.rationale: This sits at the preferred position. The only Company payment obligation is a pure revenue share — 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000 monthly floor — so the Company pays only on actual sales generated through the Site and owes nothing if sales do not occur. There is no minimum spend, guaranteed volume, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume cap anywhere in the Agreement (searches for "minimum", "commit", "guarantee", "volume", "shortfall", "purchase" and "take or pay" return nothing), and HDI bears all development, hosting and promotion costs (Sections 1.2, 1.6, 1.8), with the Company bearing only its own order-processing costs (Section 2.2). The Section 4.2 Termination Payment is an exit fee tied to trailing Net Sales, not a purchase or volume commitment; it is capped at zero on the downside and is properly reviewed under the termination/liquidated-damages rules rather than double-flagged here. Note in passing that the Section 6.1 exclusivity restricts the Company's own Deerskin web activity, which is an exclusivity issue, not a volume commitment. No redline required.
